bio.text: Darshana R. Patel was elected to the California State Assembly in November 2024 to represent the 76th Assembly District in northern San Diego County, including Escondido and San Marcos. She chairs the Assembly Education Committee.

Before the Legislature she spent nearly a decade as a biotechnology research scientist, then served on the Poway Unified School District Board of Education and as president of the San Diego County School Boards Association.
She earned a bachelor's degree in biochemistry from Occidental College and a Ph.D. in biophysics from the University of California, Irvine, and lives in San Diego.
